Job setup

Electrons and symmetry

The table gives the system’s electrons, charge, spin and point group; the nuclear charges Z_A and the total charge q set the electron counts and multiplicity:

N_\alpha+N_\beta=\sum_A Z_A-q,\qquad M_S=\frac{N_\alpha-N_\beta}{2},\qquad 2S+1=N_\alpha-N_\beta+1

Route keywords

Route keywords

The route selects the method, the basis set and the job type.

Link 0 commands

The Link 0 commands set this job’s memory, processors and files.

Molecule

Molecule specification

The specification gives the title, the charge and the spin multiplicity, and where the geometry comes from.

Starting geometry

The viewer shows the structure the input starts from.

Computed results

Excitations and spectrum

Excited states

The job solved for 10 excited states.

Calculated spectrum

The chart places each state at its wavelength \lambda_n with its oscillator strength f_n, over ultraviolet bands.

Oscillator strength measures the transition dipole moment \boldsymbol\mu_{0n} between the ground state and state n, the matrix element of the dipole operator \hat{\boldsymbol\mu}=-\sum_i\hat{\mathbf r}_i (atomic units):

f_n=\frac{2}{3}\,\Delta E_n\,\lvert\boldsymbol\mu_{0n}\rvert^2,\qquad \boldsymbol\mu_{0n}=\langle\Psi_0|\hat{\boldsymbol\mu}|\Psi_n\rangle=-\int\mathbf r\,\rho_{0n}(\mathbf r)\,\mathrm{d}\mathbf r

Without the symmetry of the states, only f_n tells bright states from dark ones.

Transition weights

Each bar stacks one state’s transition weights w=\sum 2c_{ia}^2, c_{ia}^2 per spin when unrestricted; amplitudes with |c_{ia}|<0.1 are not printed, and dark states, below 10\,\% of the brightest state’s f, are faded.

  • Without symmetry, point group C_1, levels are counted from the frontier.

Transition orbitals

The viewer shows the orbitals contributing at least 10\,\mathrm{\%} to a state; orange and teal mark the two phases at \pm\psi_0, holding 85\,\% of \int\psi^2\,\mathrm{d}V.

Density changes

The viewer shows each state’s density change, degenerate states grouped: blue \Delta\rho<-\Delta\rho_0 where electrons leave, red \Delta\rho>+\Delta\rho_0 where they arrive, holding 80\,\% of \int\lvert\Delta\rho\rvert\,\mathrm{d}V; amplitudes below 0.1 are left out.

Charge transfer

The hole and particle densities hold one electron each, degenerate states averaged, and q_{\mathrm{CT}}, d_{\mathrm{CT}} and S_{\mathrm{hp}} measure transferred charge, centroid distance and overlap:

\rho_{\mathrm{h}}=\frac{\sum_{ij}(\mathbf{X}\mathbf{X}^{\mathsf{T}})_{ij}\,\phi_i\phi_j}{\operatorname{tr}\mathbf{X}\mathbf{X}^{\mathsf{T}}},\qquad \rho_{\mathrm{p}}=\frac{\sum_{ab}(\mathbf{X}^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{X})_{ab}\,\phi_a\phi_b}{\operatorname{tr}\mathbf{X}^{\mathsf{T}}\mathbf{X}},\qquad \Delta\rho=\rho_{\mathrm{p}}-\rho_{\mathrm{h}}

q_{\mathrm{CT}}=\int\rho_{+}\,\mathrm{d}\mathbf{r},\qquad d_{\mathrm{CT}}=\lvert\mathbf{R}_{+}-\mathbf{R}_{-}\rvert,\qquad S_{\mathrm{hp}}=\int\sqrt{\rho_{\mathrm{h}}\rho_{\mathrm{p}}}\,\mathrm{d}\mathbf{r}

Molecular orbitals

Frontier energies and gap

The HOMO and LUMO energies set the gap:

\Delta\epsilon=\epsilon_{\mathrm{LUMO}}-\epsilon_{\mathrm{HOMO}}

Levels near the gap

The chart gives each symmetry its own column.

  • Hover a level to name it; click it to highlight it.
  • Without symmetry, point group C_1, levels are counted from the frontier.

Frontier orbitals in space

The viewer draws the orbitals chosen in its dropdowns as surfaces:

  • Surfaces hold 85\,\% of \int\psi^2\,\mathrm{d}V; the overall sign is arbitrary.
  • Parts by angular momentum l or atom A, with Mulliken shares summing to 100\,\%.

Geometry trajectory

The viewer plays every printed geometry in order, earlier frames fading.

Geometry optimization

The optimization made 18 convergence checks; forces and displacements are the maximum and RMS over the optimized coordinates.

Energy at each check

Each check’s energy is given relative to the last, E_n-E_N, so a steady fall to zero marks a smooth optimization.

Forces against their limits

The largest and RMS forces, F_{\max} and F_{\mathrm{RMS}}, are drawn against the limits Gaussian sets for convergence.

Displacements against their limits

The largest and RMS displacements \Delta q of the optimized coordinates between checks are drawn against their convergence limits.

Wavefunction convergence

The job reached 18 SCF solutions, one per geometry or state. The chart gives the cycles each one needed.

Files and resources

Checkpoints

The table lists the saved checkpoints in the order they were read and written, with their energies and gaps.

Resources

The table gives the program, the resources and the timing of the run.
